net sales.heading: Revenue Recognition
net sales.text: The Company derives its revenues from one source, the delivery of Nociscan reports to medical professionals. Revenues are recognized when a contract with a customer exists, and the control of the promised services are transferred to our customers. The amount of revenue recognized reflects the consideration the Company expects to receive in exchange for those services. Substantially all of our revenues are generated from contracts with customers in the United Kingdom and the United States.

intro.text: Aclarion, Inc., formerly Nocimed, Inc., (the “Company” or “Aclarion”) is a healthcare technology company that leverages magnetic resonance spectroscopy (“MRS”) combined with proprietary signal-processing biomarkers to optimize clinical treatments. The Company was formed in February 2015, incorporated in Delaware, and has its principal place of business in Broomfield, Colorado.
